  have h_exp_pos : ∀ ω, Real.exp (t * X ω) = Real.exp (|t| * |X ω|) ∨ Real.exp (-t * X ω) = Real.exp (|t| * |X ω|) :=
    by
      intro ω
      rw [Real.abs_mul, Real.abs_real]
      cases Real.eq_or_lt t 0 with h_t_pos h_t_neg
      · left
        rw [Real.abs_eq_self, Real.abs_eq_self]
      · right
        rw [Real.abs_eq_self, Real.abs_eq_self]
  let f := fun ω => Real.exp (|t| * |X ω|)
  have h_int_f : MeasureTheory.Integrable f μ :=
    by
      refine' MeasureTheory.integral_norm_bound _ _
      exact ht_int_pos
      exact ht_int_neg
  exact h_int_f
